The '''Sacred Forest of Naboo''' was a [[Forest/Legends|forest]] on [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It held considerable religious importance to the indigenous [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]], though its actual significance is unknown.

==History==
During the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|skirmish around planet Naboo]], the [[Central Control Computer/Legends|Central Control Computer]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] had been destroyed, and all the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s standing on the [[Great Grass Plains/Legends|Great Grass Plains]] laid inanimate.

However, through unknown technological means, a few droids were still activated, and they started destroying the sacred forests by taking down the trees. In order to halt this ecological and cultural threat, [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] decided to sent a [[Unidentified young new recruit|promising recruit]] on the spot.
